welcome.glossary:
No glossary yet. Add a `## Glossary` table to PAPER.md and Lemmaria will use it as prompt context — and enforce it on Translate.
[Create PAPER.md](command:lemmaria.createPaperMd)
config.paperEntry: The paper's main file, relative to the workspace folder — the document a blind panel (/review) reads as the whole manuscript. A project can hold several standalone documents (the paper, its supplementary, a rebuttal); this says which one is the paper. Leave empty and Lemmaria detects it. Set it with "Lemmaria: Select Paper Entry".
config.paperPdf: Path of a compiled PDF of the paper, relative to the workspace root. Leave empty to use the PDF beside the entry file, or to compile one when a review needs it.
config.model.protocol: (Legacy — models are now managed in the Models tab.) Model protocol.
config.model.model: (Legacy — managed in the Models tab; kept for migration.) Model id.
config.model.endpoint: (Legacy — managed in the Models tab.) Base URL override; empty = the protocol's default endpoint.
config.budget.maxTokens: Per-task output-token ceiling for an agentic composer session — raise it for long jobs (the default is a fallback, not a hard cap). A subagent fan-out's output also counts against it.
config.budget.maxToolCalls: Per-task tool-call ceiling for an agentic composer session (reads, searches, edits). Raise it for large jobs like surveying a whole repo. A spawn_subtask fan-out counts as ONE tool call here — the children run under their own carved budgets.
config.budget.maxTurns: Per-task model-turn ceiling for an agentic composer session. Raise it for long multi-step jobs.
config.literature.contactEmail: Optional contact e-mail sent to Crossref's polite pool with literature searches (faster, more reliable service). Leave empty to stay anonymous.
config.script.interpreters: Interpreters the agentic session's run_script tool may run (basenames, e.g. python, Rscript). Every run still needs your approval; scripts execute with your full OS permissions.
config.budget.maxFanOut: How many read-only child agents a single spawn_subtask fan-out runs CONCURRENTLY (1–8). This bounds parallel model calls (rate-limit/cost spikes); it does NOT cap how many children may be requested — extra children queue and run as slots free, so 1 runs them one at a time rather than dropping the rest.
config.verify.engine: Compile engine; auto = workspace → local TeX → tectonic guidance.
config.cost.display: Where cumulative cost (this run / today / total) is shown.
config.venues.cacheDir: Venue template cache overlay directory; empty = ~/.lemmaria/venues (ADR 0010).
config.language.description: Language for MODEL OUTPUT (session summaries, system-prompt instructions) — auto = follow the editor's display language; en/zh pins it, for a bilingual academic who reads an English UI but writes a Chinese paper. Chrome (commands, views) always follows the editor's display language, regardless of this setting.
